snippet.title: Vizier — Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The king holds the power — but the words are yours.
Vizier is a narrative court drama about the one who stands beside the throne. You serve a young king as his vizier. Every petition, every plot, every war begins as a few quiet words in his ear — and the king has a temper, fears and a will of his own. He may take your counsel, or weigh it and choose another road.
• Every counsel opens a different road, and the story follows it.
• A living realm: provinces, factions, neighboring courts and wars that answer your choices.
• A court of friends, rivals and old debts, with secrets you only learn in time.
• A life between the seasons: love, marriage and a family of your own.
• No two stories end the same way.
Vizier is coming to Steam on November 12, 2026. A free demo is available on Steam now.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4841300/Vizier/
